notes.title: Choose Your Gardener!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]A new feature has arrived in [i]Pollinarium[/i]: [b]Gardeners[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700651/3d501f3606228fead0d5e46978975eee52fa52dd.png"][/img]At the start of each run, you'll now pick a [b]Gardener[/b], each with their own unique perks [i]and[/i] tradeoffs, that changes how you approach your garden. It will allow you to rethink and adapt your strategy every time.[/p][p]Here are a few examples of the perks and tradeoffs:[/p][list][*][p][b]Minimalist:[/b] Positive synergies are worth 1.5x more... but you can't replant once placed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Permaculturist:[/b] Harvests are worth 20% more... but each day is 15% shorter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tinkerer:[/b] Appliance effects expand to 2 tiles... but once placed, they can’t be moved.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each of the [b]10 Gardeners[/b] offers a new way to think, plan, and grow.[/p][p][b]Status update[/b]: I’m currently running a limited playtest ahead of the demo release, it's the best way to shape things before launch![/p][p][/p][p](Psst… here’s a peek at the updated UI 👀)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700651/6e5b182f68d84106f591ae54bee4d4502a61337d.png"][/img][/p][p]What kind of perk and tradeoff would [i]you[/i] add to a new gardener? I’d love to hear your ideas.[/p][p]Happy planting 🧅🥔🍅![/p][p] (and btw... [url="https://nomadic-robot-studio.kit.com/6a130d2385"]Join the newsletter here →[/url])[/p]

notes.title: Pollinarium Has Started to Grow!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]I’m nomadicRobot, the solo dev behind Nomadic Robot Studio, and I’m thrilled to officially announce [i]Pollinarium[/i], my debut game.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Pollinarium[/i] is a minimalist, turn-based farming/gardening strategy game where you draw cards and place plants and appliances to grow the best harvest. Each garden is procedurally generated, and each run challenges you to reach a harvest goal within a set number of days. Low pressure, but plenty of strategy if you want to dig deep.[/p][p][/p][p]Have you seen the reveal trailer?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jet2DC3y5JE;full"][/previewyoutube]
